routeIdentity.finding: The source receipt and production field map bind the packet to the same adult-misdemeanor sealing route and route-selection ID.

sourceIdentity.finding: SHA-256 was independently recomputed from each mounted source byte stream and matched the source receipt.

componentSet.finding: Both fixtures contain all three receipt documents in the rendered packet.

knownPrefills.finding: Final-byte appearance evidence contains visible writes for every reported known prefill in both fixtures.

requiredBeforeFiling.finding: All 112 declared participant-supplied fields are named by form, page, printed caption, and required input in participant-instructions.md.

routeOptions.finding: The packet is restricted to the misdemeanor-sealing route; remaining checkboxes are participant sworn facts or participant elections rather than route-determined choices.

repeatingRows.finding: The independent completeness audit found no partially completed repeating row.

protectedFields.finding: Signature, signature-date, prosecutor, and court fields remain uninked in the finalized fixtures.

artifacts.finding: Canonical and boundary SHA-256 values were recomputed from the committed PDF bytes and match the rendered-artifacts record.

pageOrder.finding: Both packet manifests have the same six-page sequence: both pages of 200-00130, both pages of 200-00132, then both pages of 600-00228.

clippingAndOverlap.finding: Final-byte measurement reports zero non-whitespace glyphs outside measured write boxes for every document in both fixtures; the focused audit reports zero visual defects.

filingDestination.finding: participant-instructions.md says to supply a Superior Court unit but never affirmatively tells the participant which court or clerk receives the filing.

instructionMentions: the Superior Court unit (county) where the case was decided

feeAndWaiver.finding: The instructions explain when to use form 600-00228 but state no filing-fee amount and do not say when no fee is charged or how to confirm the current fee.

service.finding: The instructions require the State's Attorney's signature on a stipulation but never state who must be served or furnished copies, how service must occur, or whether the clerk handles notice.

selfHelpStop.finding: The instructions state that the packet is not legal advice, is not filed for the participant, and cannot decide whether sealing will be granted.
selfHelpStop.evidence: participant-instructions.md — What this packet is not

evidenceRead: mounted source bytes for forms 200-00130, 200-00132, and 600-00228
